description: This file implements the Netlink communication component within the WPEFramework core namespace. It includes functions for serializing/deserializing Netlink messages, sending/receiving data over sockets, and managing Netlink message sequences and pending requests.

classes.name: Netlink
classes.description: Handles the serialization and deserialization of Netlink messages, manages sequence IDs, and maintains message types and flags.

classes.name: SocketNetlink
classes.description: Represents a socket for Netlink communication, responsible for sending and receiving Netlink messages, managing pending messages, and handling socket state changes.

methods.name: Netlink::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the current Netlink message into a byte stream for sending over a socket.

methods.name: Netlink::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes incoming byte stream into Netlink message fields, processing multiple messages if present.

methods.name: SocketNetlink::Send
methods.description: Queues a Netlink message for transmission and triggers the socket to send the message.

methods.name: SocketNetlink::Exchange
methods.description: Sends a Netlink message and waits for a response, handling request-response pattern.

methods.name: SocketNetlink::SendData
methods.description: Prepares pending messages for sending by serializing them into the given buffer.

methods.name: SocketNetlink::ReceiveData
methods.description: Processes incoming data, matching responses to pending messages or deserializing as new messages.

methods.name: SocketNetlink::StateChange
methods.description: Placeholder for handling socket state changes.
